title: Stochastic Optimal Control of Hawkes Jump-Diffusion Systems
abstract: arXiv:2608.29473v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This paper is devoted to developing a framework for stochastic growth models with environmental risk, in which rare but catastrophic shocks interact with capital accumulation and pollution. Building on the Poisson point process formulation studied in arXiv:2511.13568, we extend the model to disasters driven by a marked Hawkes process, allowing past disasters to temporarily increase the likelihood of subsequent shocks. Our work focuses on a subcritical Markovian Hawkes specification, in which the state space is augmented by the self-excitation component of disaster risk. We establish the well-posedness and nonexplosion of the resulting controlled Hawkes dynamics. Using the Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman characterization of the corresponding Poisson control problem, we obtain quantitative estimates for the Hawkes excitation process and prove, under a small-excitation scaling, that the Hawkes value function converges to its Poisson counterpart a

translated_title: Hawkes跳跃扩散系统的随机最优控制
translated_abstract: 本文致力于建立一个包含环境风险的随机增长模型框架，其中罕见但灾难性的冲击与资本积累和污染相互作用。在arXiv:2511.13568所研究的泊松点过程表述基础上，我们将模型扩展为由标记Hawkes过程驱动的灾害，使得过去的灾害能够暂时提高后续冲击发生的可能性。我们的工作聚焦于次临界马尔可夫Hawkes设定，其中状态空间通过灾害风险的自激发分量得到扩展。我们建立了由此得到的受控Hawkes动力系统的适定性与非爆炸性。利用相应泊松控制问题的哈密顿-雅可比-贝尔曼（HJB）刻画，我们获得了Hawkes激发过程的定量估计，并证明在小激发缩放条件下，Hawkes值函数收敛到其泊松情形的对应值函数。
tldr: 本文将环境风险随机增长模型中的灾害冲击从泊松过程扩展为具有自激发特性的Hawkes过程，建立了受控Hawkes动力学的适定性与非爆炸性，并证明在小激发缩放下Hawkes值函数收敛于泊松情形的值函数。
en_tdlr: This paper extends stochastic growth models with environmental risk from Poisson-driven to self-exciting Hawkes-driven catastrophic shocks, establishes well-posedness and nonexplosion of the controlled Hawkes dynamics, and proves that under a small-excitation scaling the Hawkes value function converges to its Poisson counterpart.
